### Catch Your Breath
Author: Max Lucado
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-november-2-2017.html
Passage: Exodus 23:12
Points:
- God established weekly rest as an essential command rather than an optional lifestyle suggestion.
- Observing a regular rhythm of rest expresses reverence and humble trust in God's care.
- Chronic busyness and overwork take a severe toll on mental, physical, and emotional health.
- Genuine rest requires disconnecting from work and technology to let our minds and bodies reboot.
- Lasting tranquility comes from focusing on today's responsibilities while entrusting tomorrow's problems to the Lord.
